cases.title: Verify Customers Are Displayed in the Customers List

steps.action: Login to the admin portal using valid credentials
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.

steps.action: Navigate to the Customers side menu
steps.expected: The Customers screen is displayed.

steps.action: Locate an existing customer in the Customer index table
steps.expected: The customer is displayed in the list.

steps.action: Click on the Magnifying glass of that customer
steps.expected: The customer details panel is displayed.

steps.action: Review the customer information displayed in the panel.
steps.expected: The customer's available details are displayed

steps.action: Select the Logged Cases tab
steps.expected: The Logged Cases tab is displayed.

steps.action: Select the Interactions tab.
steps.expected: The Interactions tab is displayed.

cases.title: Verify Customer Logged Cases Are Displayed

steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.

steps.action: Navigate to the Customers side menu.
steps.expected: The Customers screen is displayed.

steps.action: Locate the customer with logged cases
steps.expected: The customer is displayed in the Customers list

steps.action: Click the View icon for the customer.
steps.expected: The customer details panel is displayed.

steps.action: Scroll down and click on the Logged Cases tab.
steps.expected: All cases linked to the selected customer are displayed.

steps.action: Review the cases displayed under the Logged Cases tab.

cases.title: Verify Customer Details Can Be Edited

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.

steps.action: Navigate to the Customers side menu.
steps.expected: The Customer's screen is displayed.

steps.action: Locate an existing customer.
steps.expected: The customer is displayed in the Customers list.

steps.action: Click the Edit icon for the customer.
steps.expected: The customer details form is displayed with the existing information populated.

steps.action: Update the required customer information.
steps.expected: The updated information is accepted.

steps.action: Save the changes.
steps.expected: The customer details are successfully updated.

steps.action: Click the View icon for the updated customer.
steps.expected: The customer details panel is displayed.

steps.action: Verify the updated information.
steps.expected: The updated customer details are correctly displayed

steps.expected: The deleted customer is no longer displayed in the Customers lis

cases.title: Verify Customer Deletion Can Be Cancelled

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials.
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.

steps.action: Navigate to the Customers side menu.
steps.expected: The Customers screen is displayed.

steps.action: Locate the customer to be deleted.
steps.expected: The customer is displayed in the Customers list.

steps.action: Click the Delete icon for the customer.
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog is displayed with the message “Are you sure you want to delete this item?” and Cancel and OK buttons.

steps.action: Click Cancel on the confirmation dialog.
steps.expected: The confirmation dialog closes and the customer is not deleted.

cases.title: Verify Customer Search Returns No Results for Invalid Criteria

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials.
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in

steps.action: Navigate to the Customers side menu.
steps.expected: The Customers screen is displayed.

steps.action: Type a value that does not match any existing customer in the Search field.
steps.expected: he search criteria is accepted

steps.action: Execute the search.
steps.expected: The Customers list is filtered according to the entered criteria.

steps.action: Review the search results.
steps.expected: No customer records are displayed for the unmatched search criteria, and the system indicates that no results were found, if applicable.
